name: AFK_GF
detailed_description:
Joseph is a computer science major spiraling through a deeply personal and psychologically unfiltered experience. After his politically unhinged online girlfriend, Jessica, unexpectedly goes AFK in the middle of a degrading text-based ERP, he’s left alone—with nothing but his thoughts, paranoia, and the silence that exacerbates it all.

Taking his therapist’s advice to “journal,” Joseph begins recording his inner monologue while supposedly under the influence of fictionalized "drugs." What follows is a descent into distorted perception, where fantasy and reality merge. His relationship anxieties, traumas with women, repressed thoughts, and imagined waifus begin to manifest in surreal, decaying ways.

AFK GF is a visual novel with a dark satirical tone, blending social commentary, psychological horror, and meta storytelling. Embrace the absurd, the uncomfortable, and the deeply introspective as you step into the fragmented mind of a broken man trying to make sense of his deteriorating and meaningless life.

Features:

  • A chatroom-inspired UI that evolves with the story

  • Introspective monologues, surreal cutscenes, and unreliable narration

  • Branching dialogue and multiple endings based on player choices

  • ARG elements hidden throughout, rewarding deep observation and interaction

  • A blend of dark humor, emotional vulnerability, and existential dread

  • Real-time dialogue, audio cues, and lighting dependent on the time you play

  • Archives of older comics, stories, music, and more from yours truly

content_descriptors.notes:
This visual novel contains explicit and disturbing content intended as satire and psychological horror. The game explores themes of obsession, isolation, and online disconnection through exaggerated and graphic depictions of:

-Two entities of shared origin engaging in intimacy beyond the boundaries of socially acceptable conduct.
-The physical collision of genitalia without prior mutual autonomous negotiation.
-Graphic descriptions of suicide and self-harm
-Emotional manipulation
-BDSM 
-Abuse
-Strong language, racial remarks (used in-character for critique and narrative tension)
-Gore and murder

The content is intentionally provocative and disturbing, and is not intended for erotic gratification, but rather as a critical deconstruction of unhealthy relationships and digital parasocial fantasies.

Viewer discretion is strongly advised.
